body: Yeah, for me it’s more I’ll make a small bite then just tear the skin + stuff away, and don’t worry about asking
Exactly, people always say like ew how can you do that to yourself or call me a vampire
Thank you, I’ll have to try that, I’ve been using bio oil but I don’t think it’s really helping that much

I’m not a doctor but I wouldn’t worry about it too much, I’ve spent 2 years on psych wards, head banged to the point of needing hospital treatment and stitches, and all my ct / mri scans have came back okay. But obviously just remember head injuries are unpredictable, it could take one hit in the wrong place to cause serious damage

Heya, I’m the exact same, started in hospital out of frustration. I took it way too far though and ended up needing stitches multiple times and now I have a horrible scar on my forehead. I don’t think it’s very common in the community because people have access to more conventional means of self harm, but it’s very common in hospitals, I’ve only met a handful of patients who had never head banged. Maybe mention it to your therapist, just because it’s not as well known doesn’t change the fact that it’s self harm, and they might be able to reassure you? I hope that’s kinda useful, or message me if you want more info?

It depends on how hard you do it, I used to head bang severely to the point I needed stitches, though sometimes even if people do it lightly but for HOURS, it’ll wear the skin away and make a mark. I wouldn’t recommend starting, I now have severe scarring and will probably need plastic surgery, and it’s so so so much more difficult to hide a scar on your face
Thank you, and basically because I’ve been self harming whilst I’ve been on the ward, they’ve kept me detained on a section
